name: Celadon Causeway
core_rationale: Western celadon-glazed stepping-stone causeway of Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary at [0, 1] leading from Ash-Bellows Trench across warm shallow mineral pools toward Sola's central medallion.

mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which melody of stepping-stones unlocks the inner dome of Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary?

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Musical celadon-glazed porcelain bridges skimming across steaming mirror-flat mineral pools.
